title: Enforce MCP/chat parity for read-only retrieval response wrappers.
description: Direct MCP retrieval and chat-agent retrieval currently agree on core source ranking, but chat can still emit duplicated structured-write disclaimer paragraphs on read-only answers. Add parity checks so read-only retrieval responses in chat use deterministic wrapper behavior: one disclaimer at most (or none when not applicable), no duplicate boilerplate, and stable formatting across equivalent MCP and chat flows. Acceptance criteria: equivalent MCP and chat prompts produce matching source selection and non-duplicative wrapper text. Validation: run side-by-side MCP unified search and chat intercept prompts and compare the rendered response output.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Evidence: the 2026-05-24 side-by-side run showed MCP unified search and chat intercept picked the same top source (`project-wiki-chat-agent-provider`), but chat rendered duplicated structured-write disclaimer text on the read-only answer.
